messages:
sre-bot: Incident detected: incidentbot heartbeat missing for 3m, paging subsystem reports 502 on notify-proxy. Alert id: alert_6271. https://internal.redwood/alerts/alert_6271

maria: did oncall get paged? no replies in #incidents thread.

devon: checking logs now, looks like webhook gateway started returning 502s around 6271772940. curl shows `HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway` to /integrations/pagerflow/send

oncall-aaron: I did not receive any pages. Phone silent. I'm oncall and available, standing by. :phone:

devon: reproducing: `curl -v -X POST https://notify-proxy.internal/integrations/pagerflow -d '{"ev":"alert_6271"}'` -> timeout then 502. headers show upstream chunked reset.

ops-shift: spinning up manual fallback: sending manual SMS + call list in 1 minute. Will post when done.

eve: any recent deploys to notify-proxy?

devon: yes, deploy at 6271769800 — small change to connection pooling. rolling back now.

sre-bot: Deploybot: rollback to notify-proxy@v2026.3 started by devon.

maria: while rollback happens, can we trigger incidentbot fallback to legacy relay? devex has an alternate endpoint.

devon: toggled fallback flag: `POST /admin/notify/fallback?enable=true` -> 200 OK. sending synthetic page test now.

sre-bot: test event: synthetic_page_test -> routed to legacy-relay, status=200.

oncall-aaron: got the synthetic page, loud ring. confirmed manual SMS earlier too. :thumbsup:

ops-shift: manual pages sent to 3 oncall numbers and support escalation list. No customer-facing page yet; monitoring customer error rate for impacted customers.

eve: initial customer impact: ~12 customers reported failed webhooks to our hosted API in last 10m, rate spike 6x. logging a P1 and notifying CS to prioritize.

maria: assigning follow-up: devon (notify-proxy rollback + connection pool investigation), eve (customer impact triage & comms), devex (incidentbot fallback hardening).

devon: rollback completed at 6271773445, notify-proxy healthy, upstream 200s. will keep an eye for flapping.

sre-bot: Incident update: paging restored via legacy fallback and rollback. Root cause suspected: connection reuse bug under high concurrency.

maria: good work. postmortem owners set. We'll keep #incidents updated if anything flares.

oncall-aaron: still monitoring, but all good from my side.

ops-shift: closing manual page run, leaving incident open for postmortem work.

maria: follow-up: run load test against notify-proxy in staging with connection pools at 10k concurrent and add synthetic monitoring for webhook 5xxs.

devon: noted. I'll open a changelist and RFC for safer rollout gating on notify-proxy.

sre-bot: Incident resolved (paging restored). Follow-up ticket: #INC-6271 (owner: devon).
_meta: generated for dataset: realistic slack incident thread about paging integration and incidentbot heartbeat; flat JSON schema per agents.md
